DEFINITION · qeva:1:empty-set@1

Empty set

The empty set is the set with no members.

editorialset-theory
Trace this conceptSearch connections

PLAIN

The idea

The empty set is the set with no members.

EXACT

The compact statement

∅ is characterized by ∀x(x∉∅); extensionality makes any two memberless sets identical.

Example

The solution set of x²=-1 over the real numbers is empty.

Boundary / caveat

Existence of an empty set is an axiom or construction depending on the foundation.

Assumptions

  • The declared set-like mathematics context is fixed.
